title: A Real Time Strategy game at correspondence speed where you build an empire across the Solar System with your friends. Trips between planets take real life days to simulate the massive distances, and games unfold over weeks of real time.
author: everybodytrustslorne
selftext:
Hello friends! I've been working on a game inspired by the idea of a slow motion stellaris you can play with your friends. The beta is out now, and I'd love feedback! It's Called Orbital Empire, and players manage an empire spanning the solar system in simulated real time, with actions and movements resolving once an hour. You can trade, battle, mine, build, and explore. The alliances and rivalries you build are real, and heavily impact the end game. Players also propose and vote on bills in the game's senate, which can change rules in either blanket or targeted ways.

[Orbital-empire.com](http://orbital-empire.com/)
